accreditation: All GSS courses are accredited by the relevant partners and awarding bodies. Please refer to GSS accreditation in about us for more details.
description: The EMBA equips professionals with the tools to navigate dynamic markets and foster competitive advantage. Through strategic frameworks and leadership development, participants will enhance their ability to inspire teams, optimize resources, and implement effective organizational practices. The program emphasizes innovation, financial acumen, and data-driven solutions to address complex business challenges. Additionally, participants will refine their understanding of human behavior and organizational structures to drive operational efficiency and collaboration.
longDescription: The Executive Master of Business Administration equips professionals with the tools to navigate dynamic markets and foster competitive advantage. Through strategic frameworks and leadership development, participants enhance their ability to inspire teams, optimise resources and implement effective organisational practices. The programme emphasises innovation, financial acumen and data-driven solutions to address complex business challenges. Participants also refine their understanding of human behaviour and organisational structures to drive operational efficiency and collaboration. The curriculum consists of at least 72 ECTS credits of postgraduate study in a modular format: 10 required modules worth 60 ECTS credits plus a final thesis or dissertation worth 12 ECTS credits, or two additional 6-credit modules focused on a specific field or industry of management.
courseDetails: This programme integrates strategic management, leadership, financial planning and marketing to foster organisational excellence. Participants explore organisational theory, behavioural insights and entrepreneurial innovation. Combining practical and theoretical approaches, the EMBA prepares leaders to adapt to global challenges and create impactful solutions. Graduates are equipped to lead teams, manage resources and drive sustainable growth.
outcomes: Assess and implement strategic frameworks that ensure organisational competitiveness and adaptability in changing markets.
Develop leadership approaches that foster innovation, align team efforts and drive long-term organisational success.
Analyse human-resource policies and practices to foster employee engagement and align people with organisational goals.
Apply strategic financial-planning techniques to optimise investment and manage organisational resources.
Design effective marketing strategies that leverage market trends and consumer insights to build competitive advantage.
Use advanced research techniques to investigate business challenges and create data-informed solutions.
Analyse and implement core management principles to enhance organisational performance and competitiveness.
Evaluate organisational structures and processes to improve efficiency and adaptability.
Analyse human behaviour within organisations to foster teamwork, motivation and a positive work environment.
Develop creative and entrepreneurial strategies that drive innovation and sustainable business ventures.
progression: The official programme listing does not publish a separate university-progression route for this EMBA. Applicants should confirm any current progression or top-up arrangement with a GSS programme adviser before enrolment.
library: Enrolled learners receive 24/7 access to the online learning-resource collection, including millions of articles and journals that support independent study and research beyond the core course materials.

entryRequirements: You are required to hold at minimum a recognised bachelor’s degree with a minimum overall score of 55% (GPA 2.0 on a 4.0 point scale) or higher.

In some instances, you may also require relevant work experience and/or research experience. If applicable, you may demonstrate this through the submission of a CV, portfolio, and/or a personal statement.
English-language proficiency must be demonstrated through one of the accepted tests unless an exemption applies.
IELTS: overall score of 5.5 or higher.
TOEIC: overall score of 555 or higher.
PTE: overall score of 50 or higher.
Duolingo English Test: overall score of 90 or higher.

The English test may be waived for native English speakers, applicants whose high-school or IB education was completed in English, applicants whose undergraduate or graduate study was completed in English, or applicants with two years of work experience in an organisation where English is the primary language of communication.
